findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the maintenance window, the link loss alarm, and the site down alarm, supporting the inference that the planned work caused the outage.
The cited anomalies and alert explicitly state that active users, availability, and download volume dropped to zero for S-SFX-005 within the specified time window.
The topology output from T2 explicitly lists the dependency chain from S-SFX-005 through LNK-SFX-01-A and AGG-SFX-01 to CORE-UPF-02.
The maintenance record MW-0005 confirms a completed fiber splice window on LNK-SFX-01-A that overlaps with the incident timeframe.
The output of T4 explicitly states that no changes occurred on the specified nodes and their parents during the queried time window.
